rationale: The accepted scope and fixed product remain valid, bounded, and unchanged, but Stage 8 cannot proceed without public technical evidence. The snapshot verifies that DUUMBI currently uses OpenAI Chat Completions (`src/agents/openai.rs`), Anthropic Messages (`src/agents/anthropic.rs`), and an OpenAI-compatible xAI client (`src/agents/grok.rs`), while the catalog lacks the required ten-model capability matrix (`src/agents/model_catalog.rs`). No official-provider research was supplied. The canonical model IDs, effort values, native API surfaces, tool compatibility, request mappings, and omitted/explicit-none semantics must not be inferred from the issue, planning notes, display names, or historical #780 error evidence.
question: Using only official OpenAI, Anthropic, and xAI public documentation, research all ten accepted models—GPT-5.6 Luna, GPT-5.6 Terra, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Fable 5.1, Grok 4.6, and Grok Build 0.1. For each model, record the canonical API ID, lifecycle/availability, supported reasoning-effort values, omitted-effort behavior, explicit-none support or rejection, tool and non-tool compatibility, required API surface, native request field mapping, response mode, prerequisites, exact official HTTPS sources, retrieval date 2026-09-16, and concise supporting excerpts. Classify every capability as verified support, documented non-support, or unverified; do not infer IDs or capabilities from product branding or subscription availability.
